summary: Closed both halves of the snapshot-artifact containment defect: git-snapshot.sh's --no-revert untracked-file backup is now narrowed to the dispatching task's file_scope, and git-commit-phase.sh's fixed staging seed conditionally excludes both snapshot artifact classes. Registered untracked-backup-*/ as the 28th ephemeral runtime-file class member and reconciled every coupled surface. Two regression cases were demonstrated failing against the unmodified scripts and now pass; deploy-headless.sh reported RESULT=landed_verify_clean twice (the second after fixing a stale pre-existing test count the new class member exposed).

artifacts.summary: Closed both halves of the snapshot-artifact containment defect with a demonstrated-RED-to-green regression pair, new ephemeral class member, and clean redeploy.
